headline: Brief Reports Marcos Security Directive as AFP Pursues Gunmen in BARMM Convoy Attack
seoTitle: Brief: Marcos Security Directive After BARMM Convoy Attack
seoDescription: An FMB News evening brief reports a presidential directive for tighter BARMM security and AFP pursuit operations after the reported attack on Chief Minister Macacua's convoy.
deck: The evening package presents the national government's reported response to the Bangsamoro convoy attack.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The FMB News brief reports that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordered heightened security and pursuit operations after the reported attack on Interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua's convoy.

The package cites specific Inquirer links placing the attack in Barangay Dulangan, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, and says Macacua and his escorts were unharmed. Because the underlying PCO and AFP releases were not independently reproduced in the final pass, the directive and incident specifics remain source-attributed.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: This is an update to the earlier source-attributed BARMM incident report.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A national security response to violence against BARMM leadership bears directly on the peace process and civilian confidence in regional stability.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for PCO, AFP WestMinCom, 6th Infantry Division and PRO-BAR incident updates.
